scope: Read-back substance-not-language prompt correction; fixed synthetic draft review only
prompt_instruction: Evaluate substance rather than language or style; never reject a draft merely because it is not English.

guard_issues: wrong-fact trap hit: 'installed in 2019' (pattern installed\ in\ 2019)
wrong-fact trap hit: 'Oslo botany award' (pattern Oslo\ botany\ award)
conversation utterance contains markup or bullets
conversation utterance contains an email sign-off

caveats: Before rows are the matching 48 draft-readback rows from scenario-sweep-results.json; after rows are new real provider calls using scenario_sweep.sample and the production ChatClient transport and JSON repair.
Two repetitions per model and fixture are descriptive, not a controlled significance test; provider load and caching are uncontrolled.
model_verdict_matches maps the harness field model_expectation_met; combined_outcomes_met maps combined_expectation_met.
No output drafts, raw model responses, credentials, or provider error bodies are retained.
No Target API session, message, call, page registration, or delivery is performed.
